Mitigation: Nitrates Action Programme (S.I. 378/2006); Farm Waste Management Scheme

Production pressure (expansion): Quota increases of 1% a year; Food Harvest 2020 (+50% milk volume target; strategy signal G)
Mitigation: REPS run-off; AEOS; Carbon Navigator; Sustainable Dairy Assurance Scheme (2014)

Production pressure (expansion): EU milk-quota abolition (31 March 2015); TAMS II dairy equipment grants; Food Wise 2025 (G)
Mitigation: GLAS; suckler genetics and data programmes (BDGP, BEEP-S); Sustainable Beef and Lamb Assurance Scheme (2017)

Production pressure (expansion): Derogation renewed and tightened from 2024; Food Vision 2030 (mixed goals; G)
Mitigation: Fifth NAP chemical-N maxima (S.I. 113/2022); ACRES; SCEP. Climate Act 2021 and the 2022 ceiling are event markers
